Policies and Initiatives.title: One lesson no longer fits all: AI personalises English learning in schools
Policies and Initiatives.summary: Hundreds of students in government schools across Punjab are using an AI-assisted English learning programme that allows them to learn at their own pace. The programme has replaced the traditional uniform curriculum, providing a personalized learning experience for each student. Many students have shown significant improvement in their English skills since the initiative's implementation.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Pilot project introduces AI learning in govt schools
Policies and Initiatives.summary: The Punjab state School Education Department is introducing AI, robotics, Internet of Things (IoT), and cyber safety education in 425 government schools as a pilot project. This initiative aims to equip government school students with advanced technological skills. The project is part of Mission RAFTAAR, a program focused on promoting robotics and AI learning.

Policies and Initiatives.title: ONDC to raise Rs 430 Cr from SBI, Zoho, Uber,  Paytm, Amul and others
Policies and Initiatives.summary: The Open Network for Digital Commerce (ONDC) is raising Rs 430 crore from strategic investors, including Zoho, Uber, Paytm, and SBI, to fuel its next phase of growth under the ONDC 2.0 strategy. ONDC has already received Rs 220 crore, with Zoho contributing the largest amount of Rs 70 crore, followed by Uber and Paytm with Rs 60 crore each. The investments are part of ONDC's plan to expand its digital commerce network.

Major AI Developments.title: World Youth Skills Day: As AI reshapes jobs, Chandigarh’s skill institutes race to bridge training gap
Major AI Developments.summary: On World Youth Skills Day, Chandigarh's skill institutes are working to bridge the training gap as AI reshapes jobs. The institutes are adapting to the changing job market by providing relevant training to students. This effort aims to equip young people with the skills needed to thrive in an AI-driven workforce.

Major AI Developments.title: CBSE expands AI curriculum, but Centre rejects Chandigarh’s Rs 95L plan for govt schools
Major AI Developments.summary: The Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) has expanded its artificial intelligence (AI) curriculum. Meanwhile, the Centre has rejected Chandigarh's proposal to implement an AI plan worth Rs 95 lakh in government schools. The rejected plan was intended to enhance AI education in government schools.

Major AI Developments.title: Three face FIR for morphing two sisters’ photos with AI, sharing them online
Major AI Developments.summary: Three individuals are facing an FIR for using AI to morph photos of two sisters and sharing the manipulated images online. The accused, traced to Punjab, are being pursued by police teams. The incident highlights the misuse of AI technology for malicious purposes, such as creating and disseminating fake content.

Major AI Developments.title: Pargat targets AAP over ‘AI videos’ against jathedars
Major AI Developments.summary: Pargat has accused the Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) of creating AI videos targeting jathedars. The AI videos are allegedly being used to defame the jathedars, sparking controversy. Pargat's accusation suggests a deepening political rift between him and the AAP.

Major AI Developments.title: AAP accuses Cong of using AI-generated deepfake to target CM Mann
Major AI Developments.summary: The Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) has accused the Congress of using an AI-generated deepfake to target Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann. The AAP alleges that the Congress created and disseminated a manipulated video to defame the CM. This incident highlights the growing concern of deepfakes being used for political sabotage.

Major AI Developments.title: City plans hub for AI innovation, governance
Major AI Developments.summary: The city of Chandigarh is planning to establish a hub for AI innovation and governance at the Chandigarh IT Park. This facility aims to promote artificial intelligence development and regulation in the region. The hub will serve as a central location for AI-related activities, fostering growth and innovation in the field.

Major AI Developments.title: Financial help pours in as Ludhiana daily wager’s daughter makes AI course cut at IIT-Guwahati
Major AI Developments.summary: Harpreet Kaur, daughter of a daily wage labourer, has secured admission to an AI course at IIT-Guwahati. Despite her academic achievement, she struggled to arrange the admission fee due to her family's financial weakness. Financial help has now poured in to support her education.

Major AI Developments.title: Technology pact brings AI weather intel to Punjab farms.
Major AI Developments.summary: A technology pact has been formed to provide Punjab farms with AI-powered weather intelligence. This partnership aims to leverage artificial intelligence to enhance weather forecasting and support agricultural decision-making in the region. The initiative is expected to benefit local farmers by providing them with more accurate and reliable weather information.

Major AI Developments.title: Punjabi University, PGIMER develop AI tool for rare skin disease diagnosis
Major AI Developments.summary: Punjabi University and PGIMER have developed an AI tool for diagnosing rare skin diseases. The tool utilizes artificial intelligence to aid in the diagnosis of these conditions. This collaborative effort aims to improve diagnosis accuracy for rare skin diseases.

Major AI Developments.title: PGI combines AI and ultrasound for early gallbladder cancer detection
Major AI Developments.summary: The Postgraduate Institute of Medical Education and Research (PGI) is utilizing a combination of AI and ultrasound technology to detect gallbladder cancer at an early stage. This innovative approach aims to improve diagnosis and treatment outcomes for patients. The PGI's method has shown promise in identifying gallbladder cancer more accurately and efficiently.

Major AI Developments.title: Punjab Police deploy AI-powered tool PAIS to crack down on global gang networks
Major AI Developments.summary: Punjab Police has deployed an AI-powered tool called PAIS to combat organized crime, utilizing a voice recognition system with a database of over 84,000 known criminal and suspect voice samples. The system aims to crack down on global gang networks, including those operating from countries like Canada and the US. Nearly 60 notorious gangsters linked to Punjab are being targeted through this initiative.

Major AI Developments.title: Amritsar Class 10 student lands ISRO’s YUVIKA programme after ChatGPT suggestion
Major AI Developments.summary: Manak Jain, a Class 10 student from Amritsar, was accepted into ISRO's Young Scientist Programme, known as YUVIKA. She discovered the opportunity after asking ChatGPT for suggestions on how to spend her school break productively. The programme is a coveted opportunity for young students to learn from ISRO scientists and gain hands-on experience.

Major AI Developments.title: Punjab news: On cards, AI as core subject in schools
Major AI Developments.summary: The Punjab Education Department plans to introduce artificial intelligence (AI) as a core subject in schools during the current academic session. AI will be taught as an introductory subject for classes up to Class V, and as a core subject from Class VI to XII. The introduction of AI is expected to take place in the coming days for higher classes.

Major AI Developments.title: ’13 bombs’ threat: Punjab and Haryana High Court targeted in AI-generated threat mail
Major AI Developments.summary: The Punjab and Haryana High Court received a threat email claiming 13 bombs had been planted in the building. The email was generated using artificial intelligence, according to reports. Authorities are investigating the threat, which has raised security concerns at the court.

Major AI Developments.title: IIT-Ropar to deploy 100 AI weather stations across Punjab
Major AI Developments.summary: IIT-Ropar is set to deploy 100 AI-powered weather stations across Punjab. The initiative aims to provide accurate and real-time weather forecasts, leveraging artificial intelligence technology. The deployment of these weather stations will enhance weather monitoring and prediction capabilities in the region.

Major AI Developments.title: Crop diversification necessary to ensure sustainability: Experts at Kisan Mela in Ludhiana
Major AI Developments.summary: Experts at the Kisan Mela in Ludhiana emphasized the need for crop diversification to ensure long-term sustainability. The two-day event, held at Punjab Agricultural University, featured officials and experts discussing the importance of diversifying crops. ML Jat, secretary of the Department of Agricultural Research and Education, was the chief guest and highlighted the issue during the event.

Major AI Developments.title: AI video linked to Golden Temple triggers row, SGPC orders probe
Major AI Developments.summary: An AI-generated video linked to the Golden Temple has sparked controversy, prompting the Shiromani Gurdwara Parbandhak Committee (SGPC) to order an investigation. The video's content has not been specified, but it has triggered a row, leading to the SGPC's probe. The SGPC is looking into the matter to determine the circumstances surrounding the creation and dissemination of the video.

Major AI Developments.title: Punjab to integrate AI across depts; Mohali to be AI hub
Major AI Developments.summary: Punjab plans to integrate artificial intelligence across its departments to enhance efficiency. The city of Mohali is set to be developed as a hub for AI, driving innovation and growth in the region. This initiative aims to leverage AI technology to improve governance and public services in Punjab.

Major AI Developments.title: Three arrested by Punjab cybercrime police for online fraud, AI blackmail
Major AI Developments.summary: Punjab cybercrime police have arrested three individuals for their involvement in online fraud and AI blackmail. The arrests were made as part of the police's efforts to combat cybercrime in the region. The suspects allegedly used AI technology to blackmail and defraud victims online.

Major AI Developments.title: Value of AI is unlocked only through discipline, says governance expert at Punjab Agricultural University.
Major AI Developments.summary: A governance expert at Punjab Agricultural University emphasized that the value of AI can only be unlocked through discipline. This statement highlights the importance of responsible and structured approaches to leveraging artificial intelligence. The expert's remarks underscore the need for careful governance and management of AI systems to maximize their potential benefits.

Major AI Developments.title: HC notice to Centre, others on plea for regulation of AI-generated content
Major AI Developments.summary: The High Court has issued a notice to the Centre and other parties regarding a plea for regulation of AI-generated content. The notice is in response to a petition seeking guidelines to control and monitor AI-generated content. The court's decision is pending, with the Centre and other parties required to respond to the plea.

Major AI Developments.title: Cyber cons made off with Rs 740 crore in five years in Punjab
Major AI Developments.summary: Punjab reported over 35,000 cybercrime complaints in 2024, with significant financial losses, including Rs 740 crore in the past five years. AI-powered cybercrime is targeting seniors and even educated individuals, who are losing their savings to sophisticated scams. Experts are urging digital awareness and caution against hasty online actions to prevent such losses.

Major AI Developments.title: BFUHS joins Consortium of Innovative Health Universities at India AI Impact Summit
Major AI Developments.summary: Baba Farid University of Health Sciences (BFUHS) has joined the Consortium of Innovative Health Universities at the India AI Impact Summit. This collaboration aims to leverage artificial intelligence in the healthcare sector, although specific details of the partnership are not provided. The summit facilitated the union, promoting innovation and AI adoption in health universities.

Major AI Developments.title: SGPC to meet AI firms to curb misleading content
Major AI Developments.summary: The Shiromani Gurdwara Parbandhak Committee (SGPC) plans to meet with AI firms to address the issue of misleading content. The goal is to curb the spread of false information, particularly related to the Sikh community. The SGPC aims to collaborate with AI companies to find a solution to this problem.

Major AI Developments.title: Objectionable AI video of Golden Temple spark outrage
Major AI Developments.summary: An AI-generated video featuring the Golden Temple in an objectionable manner has sparked widespread outrage. The video's content has not been specified, but it has drawn strong reactions from the public. The incident highlights growing concerns over the misuse of AI technology to create offensive content.

Major AI Developments.title: AI in the orchard: Punjab Agricultural University for adopting smart horticulture.
Major AI Developments.summary: Punjab Agricultural University is adopting smart horticulture by utilizing AI in orchards. The initiative aims to improve efficiency and productivity in the horticulture sector. The university is promoting the use of AI technology to enhance farming practices and decision-making.

AI Start-Up News.title: Doodhvale Farms raises $1 Mn from Atomic Capital
AI Start-Up News.summary: Doodhvale Farms, a direct-to-consumer dairy brand, has raised $1 million in a follow-on funding round from Atomic Capital Fund I. This investment follows a $3 million Series A funding round in November 2024, co-led by Atomic Capital and Singularity Early Opportunities Fund. The new capital will be used for market expansion and increasing distribution in existing markets.

AI Start-Up News.title: Prashant Pitti’s Optimo Capital raises Rs 100 Cr from PNB
AI Start-Up News.summary: Optimo Capital, a tech-led NBFC, has raised Rs 100 crore in debt funding from Punjab National Bank and partnered with Godrej Finance to co-lend Rs 200 crore over 12 months. This development comes six months after the company secured Rs 150 crore in equity funding led by Blume Ventures and Omnivore. Optimo Capital focuses on MSME lending, offering digital secured loan-against-property products to borrowers with limited access to formal credit.

AI Start-Up News.title: Rajpura lineman’s daughter uses AI to secure 51st rank in UPSC exam
AI Start-Up News.summary: A lineman's daughter from Rajpura used AI to aid her studies and achieved the 51st rank in the UPSC exam. This notable achievement highlights the potential of AI in enhancing learning outcomes. The daughter's success is an inspiring example of how technology can help bridge the gap and facilitate academic excellence.
